segment.source: The scopes of the mirrored source with their diff and actions, the loss report and the settings arrive with the next packages of the Windows takeover.

segment.source: The flip turns a secondary zone into a primary zone in place with the SOA and NS values you give, and back; it arrives with a later package of the Windows takeover.

segment.source: The release turns the frozen names a takeover did not adopt into manual records, or deletes them; it arrives with a later package of the Windows takeover.
